    # Get opponent positions, default to empty list if not present

    def move_towards(target_positions):

        closest_target = min(target_positions, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-x) + abs(t[1]-y))
        dx = 0

        if closest_target[0] > x:

        elif closest_target[0] < x:
            dx = -1
        if closest_target[1] > y:

        elif closest_target[1] < y:
            dy = -1
        return dx, dy

    # Policy depending on game mode

        # Seek nearest resource
